summary: Tested Venture Path gamification revamp: tiered badges (bronze/silver/gold), Founder Progress Score rename, encouraging AI prompt, backwards-compat score parsing, and updated UI. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_venture_path.py from 7 -> 19 cases; all 19 pytest cases pass. Frontend /venture-path renders correctly with all required data-testids; seeded student with score=72 on week-3 milestone shows Module 3 Silver chip + '13 pts to Gold' hint + counts (0 Gold / 1 Silver / 0 Bronze). Trend chart renders with Bronze/Silver/Gold reference lines. Best-attempt callout displayed.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/student/venture-path docstring still says 'A badge unlocks the moment ANY submission ... scores >= 80' — stale after the tier refactor; should be updated to reflect Bronze=50/Silver=70/Gold=85. Non-functional, cosmetic doc drift.
server.py is 7971 lines — long-standing recommendation to split into routers still stands (not new).
test_credentials: Seeded ephemeral TEST_ student + session in Mongo per test_credentials.md pattern; cleaned up post-test.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral per-test students (TEST_-prefixed users, sessions, cohorts, assignments, submissions). Threshold parametrization uses one fresh student per case. All cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_venture_path.py now covers: parse_readiness_score (Progress + legacy Readiness labels), INVESTOR_SCORE_INSTRUCTION string content, badge_tier_for thresholds, auth 401/403, empty-student shape with new tier fields, unlock (gold at 85), tier threshold matrix (49/50/69/70/84/85/100), and best-of-many-attempts (45 then 72 -> silver). Frontend session pattern: set localStorage.thinkific_session_token = <token from user_sessions>, then navigate to /venture-path.
